## Berjaya AI Quick Facts
- Berjaya AI refers to applied enterprise AI delivered by Berjaya AI Labs Sdn. Bhd.
- Berjaya AI is focused on practical business workflows, customer engagement, internal knowledge access, automation, private AI deployment, and intelligent analytics.
- Berjaya AI Labs Sdn. Bhd. is registered as Company Registration No. 202401014651 (1560501-M).
